group of people moving in a certain direction, usually in an organized fashion
process by which liquids or other inanimate objects move from one place to another
s.g: to move; to go; to walk; to flow

s.d: action by which humans, deities, or animals move forward, usually towards a specific destination
action by which humans, deities, or animals move through an area without a specific destination
s.g: to walk about; to wander; to roam

s.d: causative action or process by which humans or deities cause (other) humans or objects to move forward, usually towards a specific destination
s.g: to lead; to take; to bring

s.d: process by which humans or deities follow a certain pattern of behavior, ◄ which is described as their journey through life
s.g: to go > to act; to behave

s.d: causative process by which humans cause other humans to follow a certain pattern of behavior, ◄ which is described as their journey through life
literally: (one's) knees turn to water; hence: = to lose (one's) courage
literally: to go; hence: = process by which living creatures live their life until the moment of death
process by which someone is going to die, described as a movement in one way only
process by which an object vanishes from existence
process by which events take place, ◄ as if they move like objects
literally: to go away; hence: = process by which an event stops happening
literally: to bring (one's) shame; = causative process by which humans deal with their shame
s.g: to bring (one's) shame > to hide (one's) disgrace

s.d: literally: to go to (one's) life; hence: = action by which humans move away from a certain place in order to save their life from danger
process by which events continue over a prolonged period of time, ◄ described as movement along time
person who spends much time on the road, either as well-intentioned traveller or as roaming vagabond
literally: to walk at (someone's) feet; hence: = action by which humans accompany other humans to serve them
action by which humans approach (other) humans for having sexual relations
s.g: to go to > have sex with

s.d: state in which something exists in space, of which the existence is described as a movement from one place to another
process by which a liquid flows from a certain place
person who is on a journey from one place to another
process by which an object emits or reflects light; ≈ regarded as awesome
s.g: to shine; to flash forth; to emit (light)

s.d: action by which humans or divine beings express their appreciation, admiration, respect, and/or gratitude to (other) humans or deities about who they are and what they do

action by which humans express their pride and satisfaction about themselves, their actions, certain circumstances they find themselves in, or a deity that they consider responsible for those circumstances
state in which humans experience great joy and act accordingly
state in which an action is regarded as abnormal and associated with people who are insane
action by which humans act in a way that is regarded as abnormal and associated with people who are insane
s.g: to behave madly; to go mad

s.d: causative action by which deities or humans cause (other) humans to either become fools or look like fools
action by which vehicles move at a larger speed than is considered responsible, ≈ which is associated with insane behavior
s.g: to rage; to charge madly; to dash wildly

s.d: man; ► father of {L:Abdon<SDBH:עַבְדֹּון>}, judge
action by which humans or animals deliver a blow to an object with their hands, whether or not with the help of an instrument such as a {L:hammer<SDBH:הַלְמוּת>}, or with their feet
causative action by which alcoholic drinks have a numbing effect on humans, comparable to being beaten by a hammer
s.g: to beat; to make numb; to overcome

s.d: a reference to the location of the speaker
a reference to an imprecise location away from the speaker
s.g: in all directions; hither and tither

s.d: a reference to the present as the temporary endpoint of an event begun in the past
man; ◄ tribe of {L:Asher<SDBH:אָשֵׁר>}

instrument of about 30 centimeters long, consisting of a handle, usually made of wood, to which was attached a stone, wooden, or (less frequently) metal head; ► used for many purposes, including the breaking or dressing of building stones, pounding nails or pegs into wood, or pounding pegs into the ground; also used by blacksmiths to shape hot metal
a reference to a group of masculine (and possibly including feminine) participants
location ► inhabited by the {L:Zuzites<SDBH:זוּזִים>}
action by which humans, animals, or objects produce a variety of sounds, often associated with animals, but also with natural phenomena like the waves of a stormy sea
s.g: to moan; to groan; to roar; to growl

s.d: action by which humans speak loudly, ≈ often associated with a lack of wisdom
s.g: to be in tumult; to be in uproar; to be loud

s.d: state in which the traffic in streets makes much noise
state in which humans possess a large quantity of goods
action by which humans, animals, or objects produce a variety of sounds, sometimes associated with natural phenomena like heavy rain and the waves of a stormy sea
state in which objects are abundant in quantity
a large group of people
valley, ◄ possibly located east of {L:Dead Sea<SDBH:יָם־הַמֶּלַח>}
s.g: Valley of Hamon-Gog; Valley of Gog's Horde

s.d: exact meaning unsure; literally: to rage, to be turbulent; hence, probably: = state in which humans are unwilling to live a life conforming to certain rules and regulations
town, ◄ located in the valley where the army of {L:Gog<SDBH:גֹּוג>} is defeated
process by which a musical instrument produces sounds
a noise of significant magnitude, ◄ produced by a large crowd
